content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). The payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. The claim data is otherwise correct (valid dx pairing, correct COB, active eligibility), so resubmitting or correcting won't help and a resubmission risks a duplicate denial. The only legitimate progressive action against a no-auth denial here is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, which is supported by a denial on the table.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
